item.title: Han Dong-hoon Criticizes President Lee’s "YouTube Vote" – “Try a Vote on Dropping the Indictment of Lee Jae-myung” (한동훈, 李대통령 ‘유튜브 투표’ 비판 “공소 취소 투표해보라”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon Criticizes President Lee’s "YouTube Vote" – “Try a Vote on Dropping the Indictment of Lee Jae-myung” (한동훈, 李대통령 ‘유튜브 투표’ 비판 “공소 취소 투표해보라”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on the 16th criticized President Lee Jae-myung for conducting an impromptu YouTube vote on the 14th asking whether those owning so-called "ultra-high-priced" homes should bear higher ownership taxes, saying, "Go ahead and use the same method to put up a vote on the pros and cons of dropping the indictment of Lee Jae-myung." <<> Earlier, on the 14th, while presiding over a Cabinet meeting at the presidential office, President Lee was briefed on a "plan to gather public opinions on real estate policies" and said, "There is controversy over so-called 'prime single homes' – whether it's right to impose the same burden on ultra-high-priced homes worth over 10 billion won just because they are single, owner-occupied residences." He added, "Among the citizens watching the broadcast, let's try pressing button 1 or 2." <<> This was an impromptu vote targeting those watching the Cabinet meeting’s YouTube live stream. President Lee said, "If you think it's better to impose a heavier burden differentially on ultra-high-priced, owner-occupied single homes, press 1; if not, press 2." Viewers responded through the YouTube channel's chat window. President Lee also put the threshold for ultra-high-priced homes to a live vote, asking, "Press 1 for 1 billion won or more, 2 for 2 billion won or more, 3 for 3 billion won or more." <<> In response, Lawmaker Han posted on Facebook on the afternoon of the 16th saying, "President Lee put real estate tax policies to a vote among his supporters through YouTube comments during a Cabinet meeting." This implies that most viewers of the Cabinet meeting’s YouTube stream were likely supporters of President Lee. <<> Han then added, "I propose to President Lee: go ahead and use the same method to put a vote on the pros and cons of dropping the indictment of Lee Jae-myung on that YouTube channel." <<> The previous evening, Han also posted on Facebook calling President Lee's impromptu vote "appalling." Han said, "Real estate tax policies are not something to be decided by a spontaneous popularity vote among people watching the president’s YouTube channel," adding, "Asking a specific group in an unrepresentative comment section whether to impose more taxes on them evokes a modern-day people's court." <<> Han argued, "What the government should do is professional analysis and public deliberation," adding, "It should review who bears how much, what effects it has on the market and rents, and whether it aligns with tax principles, and then decide under government responsibility." He continued, "But President Lee shifted that responsibility by saying 'I asked the people watching my YouTube,'" and criticized, "Packaging reactions from his own channel's supporters as 'public opinion' is not communication." <<> Han also said, "The problem recognition is wrong," noting, "As demand concentrated on apartments priced at 1.5 billion won or less due to loan regulations, prices in districts like Seongbuk, Gangseo, Guro, and Gwanak in Seoul rose sharply in the first half of this year. The fiercest jeonse (lump-sum deposit) crisis is also not in the three affluent Gangnam districts but in the outskirts." He stated, "What the government should focus on is the collapse of the housing ladder for the middle and working classes, as apartment prices and jeonse costs surge simultaneously in Seoul's outer areas," and concluded, "Running a country is not a YouTube variety show." (이재명 대통령이 지난 14일 이른바 ‘초고가’ 주택을 보유한 사람이 보유세 등을 더 부담하도록 해야 하는지를 유튜브 즉석 투표에 부친 것을 두고 한동훈 무소속 의원은 16일 “똑같은 방식으로 ‘이재명 공소 취소 찬반 투표’를 부쳐 보라”고 비판했다.)

item.title: Cheongwadae Refutes Yoo Si-min: "Separation of Investigation and Prosecution Has Never Been Shaken" (靑, 유시민에 반박 “수사·기소 분리, 한번도 흔들린적 없다")
item.description:
Cheongwadae Refutes Yoo Si-min: "Separation of Investigation and Prosecution Has Never Been Shaken" (靑, 유시민에 반박 “수사·기소 분리, 한번도 흔들린적 없다")

The presidential office Cheongwadae stated on the 16th regarding the so-called 'prosecution reform' of the Lee Jae-myung administration that "the core value of prosecution reform, which is the separation of investigation and prosecution, has never been shaken." <<> In response to a question during a briefing about Yoo Si-min's remarks on YouTube the previous day, where he claimed that "President Lee does not want the separation of investigation and prosecution," Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said, "We do not have a separate stance or respond separately to specific individuals' remarks." <<> Yoo, appearing on the YouTube channel 'Maebulsho' on the 15th, stated, "The reason prosecution reform has not been achieved for over a year is because the President does not want a complete separation of investigation and prosecution." Yoo also criticized President Lee's handling of state affairs, saying he is "making very misguided judgments" and "heading toward inevitable failure." <<> President Lee had expressed in press conferences and elsewhere that supplementary investigative powers should be allowed in exceptional circumstances but later stated he would leave the matter to the National Assembly's judgment. The Democratic Party of Korea has proposed an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers. However, as criticism and concerns poured in from various quarters that the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers would harm victims of sexual violence and socially vulnerable groups such as children, adolescents, the disabled, and the elderly, voices within the party have recently grown louder, arguing that "the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers is unacceptable." (청와대는 16일 이재명 정부의 이른바 ‘검찰 개혁’과 관련해 “수사·기소 분리라는 검찰 개혁의 핵심 가치에 대해서는 한 번도 흔들린 적이 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House opens NSC to discuss Korea-U.S. pending issues... Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha and Fair Trade Commission attend (靑 NSC 열어 한미 현안 논의... 강경화 대사·공정위까지 참석)
item.description:
Blue House opens NSC to discuss Korea-U.S. pending issues... Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha and Fair Trade Commission attend (靑 NSC 열어 한미 현안 논의... 강경화 대사·공정위까지 참석)

The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 16th that it held a standing committee meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) chaired by National Security Director Suh Wook and discussed pending issues in Korea-U.S. trade and security sectors. (청와대는 16일 위성락 국가안보실장 주재로 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 상임회의를 개최하고 한미 통상·안보 분야 현안을 논의했다고 밝혔다.)

At the meeting, Director Suh emphasized, "In times of rising uncertainty in the external environment, we must well coordinate measures to protect national interests based on a shared understanding," and added, "Since Korea-U.S. relations combine trade and security, multiple ministries must cooperate organically to advance them to the next level," according to Cheong Wa Dae. (위 실장은 이날 회의에서 “대외 환경의 불확실성이 고조되는 시기일수록 공통된 인식을 바탕으로 국익을 지키기 위한 대처 방안을 잘 조정해야 한다”며 “한미관계는 통상과 안보가 결합한 만큼 한 단계 진전시키기 위해 여러 부처가 유기적으로 협력하여 대응해야 한다”고 말했다고 청와대는 전했다.)

In addition to regular standing committee members, Ambassador to the U.S. Kang Kyung-wha, who returned temporarily, also attended the meeting. Accordingly, it is believed that discussions on the 'Coupang issue,' which is affecting consultations in the Korea-U.S. trade and security sectors, took place. (이날 회의에는 기존 상임위원회 구성 위원 외에 일시 귀국한 강경화 주미 대사도 참석했다. 이에 따라 한미 통상·안보 분야 협의에 영향을 주고 있는 ‘쿠팡 문제’에 대한 논의가 이뤄졌을 것으로 보인다.)

Ambassador Kang told reporters at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building the previous day regarding the Coupang issue, "It’s an issue that lasts much longer than I thought." Officials from the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and the Fair Trade Commission also participated in the meeting. (강 대사는 전날 외교부 청사에서 기자들과 만나 쿠팡 문제에 대해 “제가 생각했던 것보다는 훨씬 오래 가는 이슈”라고 말했다. 재정경제부, 산업통상부, 공정거래위원회 관계자들도 회의에 참석했다.)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik Returns Home After Completing Qatar Condolence Mission (강훈식, 카타르 조문특사 일정 마치고 귀국)
item.description:
Kang Hoon-sik Returns Home After Completing Qatar Condolence Mission (강훈식, 카타르 조문특사 일정 마치고 귀국)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik returned home on the 16th after completing his mission as a special envoy to convey condolences to former Qatari Emir Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. <<> According to the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, Chief Kang arrived back in the afternoon of the 16th after paying respects to Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, the former monarch of Qatar, who passed away on the 12th. Kang attended the condolence ceremony at the Lusail Palace in Qatar on the 15th local time and conveyed President Lee Jae-myung’s heartfelt condolences to King Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. <<> Cheong Wa Dae reported that King Tamim expressed gratitude to the South Korean government for dispatching a high-level condolence delegation during a difficult time, noting that this would help elevate bilateral relations to a higher level. <<> Chief Kang also held discussions with Qatar’s Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, and Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defense Affairs, Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani. During these meetings, Kang assessed that the legacy of the former emir, symbolized by the 'Qatar National Vision 2030,' had laid the groundwork for the establishment of a comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries in 2023. He also expressed hope for expanding the horizons of cooperation based on the trust between the two nations’ leaders. <<> Upon arriving at the airport, Kang met with reporters and explained, “The people in Qatar were also concerned about the situation in the Middle East. We conveyed South Korea’s commitment to deep solidarity with Qatar and promised to further strengthen our cooperative relationship until the conflict in the Middle East ends.” <<> Earlier, President Lee sent a condolence message regarding the passing of former emir Hamad. It was reported that during the government’s consultations on sending a condolence envoy, Qatar specifically requested Chief Kang for the mission. Kang had previously visited Qatar in April as a special envoy for strategic economic cooperation, meeting with King Tamim to discuss energy supply chains and economic collaboration plans. (강훈식 대통령 비서실장이 카타르 하마드 빈 칼리파 알 싸니 부왕 조문특사 일정을 마치고 16일 귀국했다.)

item.title: People Power Party to Boycott Constitution Day Event... "No Progress in Assembly Formation Talks" (국민의힘, 제헌절 행사 불참…“원 구성 협상 진척 없어”)
item.description:
People Power Party to Boycott Constitution Day Event... "No Progress in Assembly Formation Talks" (국민의힘, 제헌절 행사 불참…“원 구성 협상 진척 없어”)

The People Power Party (PPP) has decided to boycott the National Assembly's Constitution Day event scheduled for the 17th. The move comes as a protest against the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), which has maintained an uncompromising stance in negotiations over the "second-half assembly formation" and the "Election Commission special counsel law," leveraging its majority seats. Although Constitution Day has been reinstated as a public holiday for the first time in 18 years, the parliamentary event to mark it is expected to be a "half-hearted ceremony" amid extreme confrontation between the ruling and opposition parties. <<> Floor leaders of both parties met at the National Assembly for talks on this day but failed to bridge their differences, parting ways after just over 10 minutes. PPP Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik told reporters immediately after the meeting, "There has been no progress, so today's talks have been concluded, but we will continue discussions. It's not yet at the stage of a complete breakdown," adding, "I believe it's difficult to participate in the Constitution Day event under these circumstances." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also indicated that he would skip the Constitution Day event and instead attend a rally at Olympic Park. <<> National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik had requested both parties to complete the assembly formation before Constitution Day, but negotiations remain at a standstill. The PPP insists that it must secure the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and that the opposition party should have the right to recommend candidates for the Election Commission special counsel bill. DPK Floor Leader Han Byeong-do told reporters earlier, "We are still in discussions, so nothing has been concluded," adding, "We will continue further consultations to normalize the assembly formation." <<> The 78th Constitution Day commemorative ceremony, hosted by the National Assembly, is scheduled to be held at 10 a.m. on the 17th in the Central Hall of the National Assembly. Attendees will include National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, Constitutional Court President Kim Sang-hwan, Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, along with other key state figures such as Board of Audit and Inspection Chair Kim Ho-cheol, former National Assembly speakers, and leaders of political parties except the PPP. <<> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is reportedly expected to boycott the Constitution Day event. Han also did not attend the first plenary session of the National Assembly's Budget and Accounts Special Committee held on this day to elect the ruling party's floor manager. The plenary session proceeded despite the PPP's boycott in protest of the DPK's unilateral assembly formation. A close aide to Han stated, "Although he was assigned to the Budget and Accounts Committee as an independent lawmaker, he judged it best not to attend as the negotiations on assembly formation between the ruling and opposition parties are not yet concluded." (국민의힘이 17일 열리는 국회 제헌절 행사에 불참하기로 했다. 더불어민주당이 다수 의석을 앞세워 ‘후반기 원(院) 구성’과 ‘선관위 특검법’ 협상 과정에서 양보 없는 태도를 이어가자, 이에 항의하는 차원에서 제헌절 행사에 참석하지 않기로 한 것이다. 18년 만에 제헌절이 다시 법정 공휴일이 됐지만, 이를 기념하는 국회 행사는 여야의 극한 대립으로 ‘반쪽 기념식’이 될 전망이다.)

item.title: 'Spitting While Lying Down'? In the North, 'A Stone Thrown While Lying Down Hits Your Own Forehead' (‘누워서 침 뱉기’? 北선 ‘누워서 던진 돌 이마빡에’)
item.description:
'Spitting While Lying Down'? In the North, 'A Stone Thrown While Lying Down Hits Your Own Forehead' (‘누워서 침 뱉기’? 北선 ‘누워서 던진 돌 이마빡에’)

Jeong So-un (55, photo), director (bureau chief-level) of the North Korean Human Rights Record Center, who has worked at the Ministry of Unification for 30 years, has published a book titled *"The World’s Most Pure and Excellent Language,"* which easily explains the changes in North Korean language and the contradictions of the North Korean regime hidden behind them. (30년간 통일부에 재직 중인 정소운(55·사진) 북한인권기록센터장(국장급)이 북한말의 변화와 그 이면에 담긴 북한 체제의 모순을 알기 쉽게 풀어 쓴 책 ‘세상에서 가장 순수하고 우수한 말’을 출간했다.)

Using 80 years of records from the North Korean Workers' Party newspaper *Rodong Sinmun* as primary material, the book systematically organizes the history of North Korean language, including the evolution of foreign loanwords approved by the North Korean authorities. According to it, the term 'milk cream' was officially recognized in North Korea when Kim Jong-il visited a goat farm at a military unit in 2001; previously, the term 'milky cream' (literally 'milk cream' in Korean) was used. Words like 'cow's milk bread' and 'cow's milk cookies' from the past have now changed to 'milk bread' and 'milk cookies.' (북한 노동당 기관지 ‘노동신문’ 80년 치 기록을 기본 자료로 삼아 북한말의 이력(履歷)을 정리한 책에는 북한 당국이 승인한 외래어의 변천사 등이 빼곡히 담겨 있다. 그에 따르면 북한에서 ‘밀크크림’이란 단어가 공인된 것은 김정일이 2001년 한 군부대 염소목장을 방문했을 때로, 이전에는 ‘젖크림’이란 말이 쓰였다. 과거에 쓰이던 ‘소젖빵’과 ‘소젖과자’란 말은 요즘 ‘우유빵’ ‘우유과자’로 바뀌었다.)

After Kim Jong-un came to power, expressions like 'hamberger' replaced 'meat-layered bread,' and 'waffle' replaced 'grilled bread pancake.' What was previously written in Russian style as 'espresso' has now changed to the English-style 'espresso.' Due to a lack of consistency in the scope and standards for approving loanwords, menus in Pyongyang restaurants sometimes feature 'ice coffee' and 'ice latte' (meaning iced latte) side by side. (김정은 집권 후에는 ‘고기겹빵’ 대신 ‘햄버거’, ‘구운빵지짐’ 대신 ‘와플’이란 표현이 허용됐다. 기존에 러시아식으로 ‘에스쁘렛쏘’라고 썼던 것은 요즘 영어식 ‘에스프레쏘’로 바뀌었다. 외래어 허용 범위와 기준에 일관성이 없다 보니 평양의 식당 차림표에는 ‘아이스 커피’와 ‘얼음 라떼(아이스 라테를 의미)’가 나란히 등장하기도 한다.)

In North Korea, instead of 'spitting while lying down,' people say, 'a stone thrown while lying down falls on your own forehead,' and the book neatly organizes these differences in proverbs between South and North. It also mentions that after 'Jang Tong-il' appeared in *Rodong Sinmun* in 2020, the name 'Unification' is no longer seen in the newspaper. (북한에서는 ‘누워서 침 뱉기’ 대신 ‘누워서 던진 돌 제 이마빡에 떨어진다’고 한다는 등, 남북 간 서로 다른 속담도 책 속에 잘 정리돼 있다. 2020년 ‘장통일’씨가 노동신문에 등장한 후, 더 이상 통일이란 이름이 신문에서 보이지 않는다는 얘기도 나온다.)

Cases of twins with unique names often introduced in *Rodong Sinmun* also draw attention. Triplets attending Kim Il-sung University are named Ri Chin-hyeok, Ri Wi-hyeok, and Ri Dae-hyeok, and the middle characters of their names combine to form 'Chinwi-dae' (meaning 'Guard'). In Gangwon Province, there are 'Chongpoktan' (meaning 'Total Bomb') triplets (Chong-il, Pok-il, Tan-il), and in Nampo City, there are 'Ilpyeondansim' (meaning 'Devoted Heart') quadruplets (Kim Il-sun, Kim Pyeon-sun, Kim Dan, Kim Sim-sun). (노동신문에 종종 소개되는 독특한 이름의 쌍둥이들 사례도 눈길을 끈다. 김일성종합대학에 다니는 세 쌍둥이 이름은 리친혁·리위혁·리대혁, 중간 글자를 합치면 ‘친위대’다. 강원도에는 ‘총폭탄’ 세 쌍둥이(총일·폭일·탄일)가, 남포시에는 ‘일편단심’ 네 쌍둥이(김일순·김편순·김단·김심순)가 살고 있다.)

There are quadruplet soldiers named 'Jogukbowi' (meaning 'Defend the Motherland') from combining their names (Baek Jo-seong, Baek Guk-seong, Baek Bo-seong, Baek Wi-seong), while quintuplets born last year took one character each from 'Chungseong Dahari' (meaning 'Fully Fulfill Loyalty') to become Son Chung-jeong, Son Seong-ryong, Son Da-jeong, Son Ha-ryong, and Son Ri-jeong. The author noted, "Names of twins, whom the authorities pay special attention to and support, cannot be chosen carelessly" and "Weaving together names of twins to create words that overtly swear loyalty is a long-standing tradition in North Korea." (형제들 이름을 합쳐 ‘조국보위’라 불리는 네 쌍둥이(백조성·백국성·백보성·백위성) 병사가 있는가 하면, 지난해 태어난 다섯 쌍둥이 이름은 ‘충성다하리’에서 한 글자씩 따온 ‘손충정·손성룡·손다정·손하룡·손리정’이다. 저자는 “당국에서 각별히 관심 갖고 지원해 준 쌍둥이들의 이름은 결코 함부로 지을 수 없다”며 “쌍둥이들의 이름을 엮어 노골적으로 충성을 맹세하는 단어가 되도록 하는 것은 북한의 오랜 전통”이라고 했다.)

Some terms have crossed from South Korea to the North, like 'yeokdaegap' (meaning 'unprecedented'). On September 22, 2017, North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho used the expression 'yeokdaegap-level hydrogen bomb test,' surprising South Korean officials. The author suggests, "It is reasonable to suspect that the supreme leader and a few political elites may have been the biggest contributors to unknowingly implanting South Korean terms into the North," as they are a class that can freely access external information blocked from ordinary residents. (‘역대급’처럼 우리 측에서 북한으로 넘어간 말도 있다. 2017년 9월 22일 리용호 북한 외무상은 “력대급(역대급) 수소탄 시험”이란 표현을 사용해 우리 당국자들을 놀라게 했다. 저자는 최고지도자와 소수의 정치 엘리트 등이야말로 “남한 말을 알게 모르게 북한에 이식하는 데 가장 크게 기여한 것은 아닌지 합리적 의심이 든다”고 했다. 일반 주민들에게는 차단된 외부 정보에 자유롭게 접근할 수 있는 계층이기 때문이다.)

The book also vividly contains the harsh insults hurled by North Korean state media at South Korean and U.S. leaders, whom North Korea considers hostile forces. *Rodong Sinmun* openly printed vulgar statements like 'smash their heads into pulp,' 'bury their mouths with cement,' 'chop off their bloated necks cleanly,' and 'twist their necks and throw them into a boiling cauldron.' (책에는 북한 관영 매체가 북한이 적대 세력으로 간주하는 한·미 지도자들을 향해 퍼부은 험악한 욕설도 여실히 담겼다. 노동신문에는 ‘대갈통을 묵사발로 만든다’ ‘세멘트(시멘트)로 주둥이를 매몰해버린다’ ‘피둥피둥한 목대를 쑥덕 잘라버린다’ ‘모가지를 비틀어 끓는 가마에 처넣는다’ 등의 막말이 그대로 실린다.)

On the radio broadcast *Joseon Central Broadcasting*, violent language such as 'stuff explosives into the bellies of the traitorous mob and blow them up without a trace' or 'I want to cut off their necks, put them on this large lathe, and shave them down' was broadcast without filter. It is said that remarks attributed to the supreme leader, like 'I’d even gouge and eat the eyes of our enemies,' were also broadcast. (라디오 방송인 조선중앙방송에서는 ‘역적 무리들의 배때기에 폭약을 집어넣고 시체도 없이 날려버리겠다’거나 ‘그놈들의 모가지를 끊어다가 이 대형 선반에 물려서 깎아버리고 싶다’ 등 살벌한 말도 여과 없이 방송됐다. 최고지도자 동지의 발언이라며 ‘적들의 눈깔도 파먹겠다’와 같은 말도 방송됐다고 한다.)

The author says that during his 30 years at the Ministry of Unification, he has read *Rodong Sinmun* almost daily and learned North Korean language like studying a foreign language. The content in the book also includes notes he jotted down in his work notebook whenever he encountered unfamiliar words and expressions in North Korean media. In the preface, the author wrote, "I thought there was a need for a book on North Korean language that ordinary people could easily read" and "Even in a situation of continued severance and lack of communication, we must understand each other's language." (저자는 통일부 재직 30년 동안 거의 매일 노동신문을 읽고 외국어 공부하듯 북한말을 익혔다고 한다. 책에 담긴 내용은 저자가 북한 매체에서 낯선 단어와 표현을 발견할 때마다 업무 수첩에 적어놨던 내용들이기도 하다. 저자는 서문에서 “평범한 사람들이 쉽게 읽을 수 있는 북한말 책도 하나쯤 필요하다고 생각했다”며 “비록 단절과 불통이 지속되는 상황일지라도 서로의 말을 알아야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee follows Kim Bo-mi’s X account targeting the 86-generation within a day of its creation (李 대통령, 86세대 직격한 김보미 X 개설 하루만에 팔로우)
item.description:
President Lee follows Kim Bo-mi’s X account targeting the 86-generation within a day of its creation (李 대통령, 86세대 직격한 김보미 X 개설 하루만에 팔로우)

President Lee Jae-myung followed the X (formerly Twitter) account of Kim Bo-mi, a 36-year-old former chairwoman of the Gangjin County Council in South Jeolla Province who is running in the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership election, within a day of its creation. Former Chairwoman Kim directly targeted the party’s mainstream 86-generation during her policy address on the 12th. She sparked controversy by saying, “In the age of AI, the 586-generation—those who once wielded Molotov cocktails and rocks—are still the mainstay of the Democratic Party.” (이재명 대통령이 더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 36세의 김보미 전 전남 강진군의회 의장의 엑스(옛 트위터) 계정을 개설 하루 만에 팔로우했다. 김 전 의장은 지난 12일 정견 발표 당시 민주당 주류인 86세대를 직격했다. 당시 “AI 시대에 화염병, 짱돌 들던 586세대가 아직도 (민주당의) 주축”이라고 해 화제가 됐다.)

Former Chairwoman Kim opened her X account on the 12th. President Lee followed the account the very next day, on the 13th. (김 전 의장은 지난 12일 X 계정을 개설했다. 이 대통령이 해당 계정을 팔로우한 건 바로 다음 날인 13일이었다.)

During her policy address, former Chairwoman Kim stated, “The pro-democracy movement should be respected, but that cannot grant the right to monopolize politics for 40 to 50 years.” She added, “In a country that should aim to become one of the three major powers in AI, should the generation that once wielded Molotov cocktails and rocks still be the mainstay?” With former Prime Minister Kim, former Representative Jeong, and Assemblymember Song—key figures of the 86-generation—present before her, she effectively called for their voluntary retirement. Former Chairwoman Kim also said, “The Democratic Party is a ‘five-none’ party, where fairness, democracy, generational change, youth, and the future have all vanished,” adding, “Because there is no fairness or democracy within the party, young people are leaving.” (김 전 의장은 정견 발표 때 “민주화운동은 존중받아야 하지만, 그것이 40~50년 정치를 독점할 권리가 될 수는 없다”며 “AI(인공지능) 3대 강국을 향해야 할 나라에서 화염병과 짱돌을 들던 세대가 아직도 주축이어야 하느냐”고 했다. 86세대 핵심인 김 전 총리, 정 전 대표, 송 의원을 앞에 두고 사실상 용퇴를 주장한 것이다. 김 전 의장은 “민주당은 공정·민주·세대교체·청년·미래가 모두 사라진 ‘5무(無) 정당’이라며 “당내에 공정도, 민주주의도 없기 때문에 청년이 떠나는 것”이라고도 했다.)

In particular, targeting former Representative Jeong, she remarked, “No one takes responsibility for young people leaving the Democratic Party; they only look out for their own interests, and the person who should be accountable is running again for one more term.” The YouTube video containing these remarks has garnered over 1.19 million views. (특히 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “청년이 민주당을 떠나는데 책임지는 사람은 없고 밥그릇만 챙기겠다며 책임져야 할 사람이 한 번 더 하겠다고 나왔다”고도 했다. 이 발언을 담은 유튜브 영상은 조회 수 119만회가 넘었다.)

In a broadcast interview that day, former Chairwoman Kim said, “Even if it’s like throwing an egg against a rock, the high-ranking figures, no matter how stubborn they are, are dead set on clinging to power. Today, I challenged the massive rock of vested interests to convey the grassroots sentiment on the ground.” She added, “The Democratic Party, having lost fairness, has also lost its youth, and without youth, the Democratic Party has no future.” <<>> (김 전 의장은 이날 방송 인터뷰에선 “계란으로 바위 치기라고 해도 높으신 분들은 죽었다 깨어나도 바닥 민심을 전하기 위해서 거대한 기득권의 바위에 오늘 도전을 했다”며 “공정을 잃은 민주당은 청년을 잃었고 청년을 잃은 민주당의 미래는 없다”라고도 했다.)

item.title: “Laid the Framework for Semiconductor Plans During Previous Term… Now It’s Crucial to Complete Them Quickly” (“지난 임기 때 반도체 계획 틀 마련… 이젠 빠르게 완성시키는 게 중요”)
item.description:
“Laid the Framework for Semiconductor Plans During Previous Term… Now It’s Crucial to Complete Them Quickly” (“지난 임기 때 반도체 계획 틀 마련… 이젠 빠르게 완성시키는 게 중요”)

“The word I’ve been saying every day lately is ‘speed.’ Speed is the most important thing.” (“제가 요새 매일 입에 달고 사는 말이 ‘스피드’입니다. 스피드가 제일 중요해요.”)

Lee Sang-il (65), Mayor of Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, said this in an interview with this newspaper on the 15th, stating, “I will expedite the development of infrastructure such as power, water, and transportation networks so that the Samsung and SK semiconductor clusters (industrial complexes) can be operational as quickly as possible.” In Yongin, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are building large-scale semiconductor clusters. These are the world’s largest semiconductor complexes. (이상일(65) 경기 용인시장은 지난 15일 본지 인터뷰에서 “삼성·SK 반도체 클러스터(산업단지)가 최대한 빨리 가동될 수 있도록 전력·용수·교통망 등 기반 시설 조성을 서두르겠다”며 이같이 말했다. 용인엔 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 대규모 반도체 클러스터를 조성하고 있다. 세계 최대 규모 반도체 클러스터다.)

Mayor Lee, a former journalist, succeeded in being re-elected in the June 3 Yongin mayoral election. This is the first time a mayor has been re-elected in Yongin. Locally, it has been assessed that “the controversy over relocating the Yongin semiconductor national industrial complex to the Honam region caused public sentiment to swing toward Mayor Lee.” (이 시장은 기자 출신으로 지난 6·3 용인시장 선거에서 재선에 성공했다. 용인에서 재선 시장이 나온 건 처음이다. 지역에선 “용인 반도체 국가산업단지의 호남 이전 논란이 일면서 표심이 이 시장에게 몰렸다”는 평가가 나왔다.)

-Your first approval after taking office was for semiconductors. (-취임 첫 결재가 ‘반도체’였다.)

“In the last Yongin mayoral election, the most common thing citizens said was ‘Please protect Yongin’s semiconductor industry to the end.’ This is about keeping promises with the citizens. If we laid the foundation for the semiconductor project in the previous term, then completing the project quickly is the most important task this time. I will make Yongin the central city of the global semiconductor industry.” (“지난 용인시장 선거에서 시민들이 가장 많이 한 얘기가 ‘용인 반도체 산업을 끝까지 지켜달라’였다. 시민들과 약속을 지키려는 것이다. 지난 임기 때 반도체 프로젝트의 기반을 마련했다면 이번엔 프로젝트를 빠르게 완성하는 게 가장 중요한 과제다. 용인을 세계 반도체 산업의 중심 도시로 만들겠다.”)

-What is the current situation? (-현재 상황은.)

“For Samsung Electronics’ national industrial complex, land compensation procedures are underway. The goal is to have the factory operational by 2029. SK Hynix is currently building its fab (factory). It is expected to be operational by February next year.” (“삼성전자 국가산업단지는 토지 보상 절차가 진행 중이다. 2029년 공장을 가동하는 게 목표다. SK하이닉스는 팹(공장)을 올리고 있다. 내년 2월이면 가동할 수 있을 것으로 보인다.”)

-What is the biggest challenge? (-가장 큰 난관이 뭔가.)

“The development of the national industrial complex site and the issue of power supply need to be sped up further. The prolonged vacancy of the LH (Korea Land and Housing Corporation) president position has delayed the ordering of site development construction for the national industrial complex compared to the original plan. As a result, there are concerns that the factory groundbreaking schedule could also face disruptions. Regarding power supply, the issue of building transmission networks remains. We are persuading the government. The government must step in actively. Only then can companies invest on time.” (“국가산업단지 부지 조성과 전력 공급 문제는 속도를 더 내야 한다. LH(한국토지주택공사) 사장 공석 사태가 장기화하면서 국가산단의 부지 조성 공사 발주가 당초 계획보다 늦어졌다. 그 여파로 공장 착공 일정에도 차질이 생길 우려가 있다. 전력 공급은 송전망 구축 문제가 남아 있다. 정부를 설득하고 있다. 정부가 적극적으로 나서야 한다. 그래야 기업들도 제때 투자할 수 있다.”)

-Transportation networks are also important. (-교통망도 중요하다.)

“A broad transportation network connecting the industrial complex with nearby cities and the Seoul metropolitan area must be built first to enhance corporate competitiveness. To this end, we are proposing to the government the construction of the Semiconductor Line, connecting Hwaseong, Yongin, and Icheon where the semiconductor cluster is located, as well as the Southern Gyeonggi Metropolitan Railway. I will also push forward without disruption the construction projects for the Yongin-Seongnam Expressway, the Second Yeongdong Connecting Expressway, and the Yongin-Chungju Expressway.” (“산업단지와 주변 도시, 수도권을 연결하는 광역 교통망을 먼저 구축해야 기업 경쟁력을 높일 수 있다. 이를 위해 반도체 클러스터가 있는 화성, 용인, 이천을 연결하는 반도체선과 경기남부광역철도 건설을 정부에 건의하고 있다. 용인~성남고속도로와 제2영동연결고속도로, 용인~충주고속도로 등 건설 사업도 차질 없이 추진하겠다.”)

-The government says it will build a semiconductor plant in Honam. (-정부가 호남에 반도체 공장을 짓겠다는데.)

“I agree with the need for balanced national development. However, the semiconductor industry is one where competitiveness can only be maintained when fabs, research and development facilities, and material, component, and equipment companies are clustered. If they are artificially dispersed, efficiency will inevitably decline. There will also be issues of overlapping investment. I believe that properly completing projects already underway is the way to enhance South Korea’s semiconductor competitiveness.” (“국가 균형 발전의 필요성에는 공감한다. 다만 반도체 산업은 팹과 연구·개발 시설, 소재·부품·장비 기업이 집적해야 경쟁력을 유지할 수 있는 산업이다. 인위적으로 분산하면 효율이 떨어질 수밖에 없다. 중복 투자 문제도 생긴다. 이미 추진 중인 프로젝트를 제대로 완성하는 것이 대한민국 반도체 경쟁력을 높이는 길이라고 생각한다.”)

-Clustering, you say. (-집적이라니.)

“The world’s top four semiconductor equipment companies are already gathering in Yongin. ASML from the Netherlands, the world’s largest semiconductor equipment company, has decided to invest 36 billion won to build a technical support facility. Japan’s Tokyo Electron is building a research and development center. Applied Materials from the U.S. recently announced a plan to establish an operational facility in Yongin. Lam Research from the U.S. is already operating a research and development center here. That’s where the competitiveness comes from.” (“세계 4대 반도체 장비 업체가 이미 용인에 모이고 있다. 세계 1위 반도체 장비 업체인 네덜란드 ASML이 360억원을 투자해 기술 지원 시설을 짓기로 했다. 일본 도쿄일렉트론은 연구·개발 센터를 짓고 있다. 미국 어플라이드 머티어리얼즈도 최근 용인에 운영 시설을 구축하는 계획을 발표했다. 미국 램리서치는 이미 연구·개발 센터를 운영 중이다. 여기서 경쟁력이 나온다.”)

-How will you use the increasing tax revenue? (-늘어나는 세수는 어떻게 쓸 건가.)

“We expect an additional tax inflow of around 1 trillion won per year starting in 2028. I will use this money to turn the Yongin Idong public housing district (20,000 households) into a ‘semiconductor-specialized new city.’ Around Idong Reservoir and Songjeon Stream, I plan to create a large lake park similar to Suwon’s Gwanggyo Lake Park. A semiconductor cluster does not succeed just by building factories. For global semiconductor companies and talent to gather, the city must be a place where people want to live.” (“2028년부터 매년 1조원 안팎의 세금이 추가로 들어올 것으로 보인다. 이 돈을 활용해 용인 이동 공공주택지구(2만 가구)를 ‘반도체 특화 신도시’로 만들겠다. 이동저수지와 송전천 일대엔 수원 광교호수공원 같은 대형 호수 공원을 만들 계획이다. 반도체 클러스터는 공장만 짓는다고 성공하는 게 아니다. 세계적인 반도체 기업과 인재가 모이려면 사람이 살고 싶은 도시가 돼야 한다.”)

-Semiconductor high schools are popular these days. (-요즘 반도체고가 인기다.)

“In March next year, a semiconductor-specialized high school will open in Yongin. It is scheduled to convert to a meister high school in 2028. It will cultivate customized talent needed for the semiconductor industry.” (“내년 3월 용인에도 반도체 특성화고가 생긴다. 2028년 마이스터고로 전환할 예정이다. 반도체 산업에 필요한 맞춤형 인재를 길러낼 것이다.”)

item.title: Even Senior Opposition Figures and Potential Presidential Candidates… Hamstrung by Judicial Risks (野 중진도, 차기 주자들도… 사법 리스크에 발목 잡혔다)
item.description:
Even Senior Opposition Figures and Potential Presidential Candidates… Hamstrung by Judicial Risks (野 중진도, 차기 주자들도… 사법 리스크에 발목 잡혔다)

With opposition politicians, including Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, facing trials and investigations, the political sphere is acutely focused on "judicial risks." There are concerns that the entire opposition could be weakened as major presidential hopefuls, metropolitan government heads, and senior lawmakers face probes and trials simultaneously. This contrasts with investigations into ruling party politicians under the current government, which have resulted in no prosecutions, leading to accusations of "biased investigations." A People Power Party (PPP) official stated, "The investigative authorities are tightening the screws on opposition figures to suit the administration's tastes." <<> On the 16th, the Supreme Court's Second Division (Presiding Justice Eom Sang-pil) upheld a lower court sentence of two years in prison and a fine of 100 million won for PPP lawmaker Kwon Seong-dong (Gangneung, Gangwon), who was indicted on charges of receiving 100 million won in illegal political funds from the Unification Church. The Kim Kun-hee Special Counsel (Special Prosecutor Min Jung-ki) indicted and arrested Kwon in October of last year on charges of receiving 100 million won in January 2022 from former Unification Church global head Yoon Young-ho, along with a request for support for the religious group. Kwon, a five-term lawmaker who served twice as floor leader and was a key figure in the PPP's old guard, lost his parliamentary seat due to the ruling, reducing the PPP's seats to 109. <<> On the 22nd, the first-instance verdict in Mayor Oh Se-hoon's political funds law violation case will be handed down. The Kim Kun-hee Special Counsel indicted Oh on charges of receiving public opinion poll results from political broker Myung Tae-kyun ahead of the 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election and having supporter Kim Han-jung pay the 30 million won survey costs on his behalf (violation of the Political Funds Act). Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho, indicted by the Insurrection Special Counsel (Special Prosecutor Jo Eun-seok) on charges of obstructing PPP lawmakers' participation in the vote to lift martial law during the emergency martial law decree (engaging in important duties for insurrection), is also undergoing his first-instance trial. Both Mayor Oh and Mayor Choo deny the relevant charges. <<> Investigations and trials targeting opposition lawmakers appear to be accelerating after the local elections. The Second Comprehensive Special Counsel (Special Prosecutor Kwon Chang-young) has notified PPP lawmakers Kim Ki-hyun and Na Kyung-won to appear on the 20th. Earlier, the special counsel announced that it had booked them along with fellow PPP lawmakers Yoon Sang-hyun and Kwon Young-jin, for allegedly obstructing the execution of an arrest warrant for former President Yoon Suk Yeol in January of last year. Subsequently, they were summoned after "not submitting written statements," prompting Na to post a receipt for a registered letter containing her written response on Facebook on the 14th, calling it "a petty political maneuver to stigmatize opposition lawmakers." The Democratic Party of Korea is set to process a revision to the special counsel law in a National Assembly plenary session on the 20th, extending the activities of the Second Comprehensive Special Counsel, which are set to end this month, by one month and increasing its dispatched public officials from 130 to 150. <<> Lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun is also on trial in the first instance on charges of gifting a luxury handbag worth 2.67 million won to Kim Kun-hee, along with his wife. Lawmaker Kim Sun-kyo is on trial on charges of granting preferential treatment to the family of Kim Kun-hee during his tenure as Yangpyeong County Governor. Lawmaker Cho Eun-hee, who served as the general election campaign headquarters head for Mayor Oh's camp during the last Seoul mayoral election, was recently referred to the prosecution on charges of receiving free public opinion polls from Myung Tae-kyun. <<> Investigations targeting independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, a former PPP leader, are also underway. The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Cyber Investigation Division recently summoned and questioned a PPP public relations official regarding the so-called "party member bulletin board case." This case involves allegations that Han's family was implicated in posts defaming former President Yoon and his wife on the PPP's party member bulletin board in November 2024. After questioning the complainant, the police conducted no significant investigation for about a year and eight months before recently resuming the probe. The Second Comprehensive Special Counsel, while investigating allegations that the Yoon Suk Yeol government interfered in an investigation into illegal remittances to North Korea by Ssangbangwool, imposed a travel ban on Han, then Minister of Justice, for over three months, but recently lifted it without even conducting a written inquiry. <<> A PPP official stated, "With special prosecutors appointed by the current government launching indiscriminate indictments through a full-scale investigation of the previous administration, major figures are shouldering heavy burdens one by one." Another official said, "Is it normal that while opposition politicians face comprehensive investigations and indictments, probes into ruling party politicians end with no charges, and the police investigation into Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Byung-ki, a former floor leader, has not reached a conclusion in over 10 months?" PPP Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik said, "It's 'guilty for the opposition, innocent for the ruling party.'" He added, "Biased investigations that oppress the opposition will surely face the judgment of history." (오세훈 서울시장과 무소속 한동훈 의원 등 야권 정치인들이 재판과 수사 대상에 오르면서 정치권이 ‘사법 리스크’에 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다. 대권 주자, 광역자치단체장, 중진 의원이 한꺼번에 수사와 재판을 받으면서 야권 전체가 위축될 가능성이 있다는 것이다. 현 정부에서 불기소가 이뤄진 여권 정치인 수사와 대비돼 “편파 수사”라는 지적도 나온다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “수사 당국이 정권의 입맛에 맞춰 야당 인사를 옥죄고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Presidential Youth Secretary Position Revived... Google Alumnus Kim Tae-won, 46, Appointed (靑 청년비서관직 부활… 구글 출신 46세 김태원)
item.description:
Presidential Youth Secretary Position Revived... Google Alumnus Kim Tae-won, 46, Appointed (靑 청년비서관직 부활… 구글 출신 46세 김태원)

President Lee Jae-myung has established the position of Secretary for Youth and Future in the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, appointing Kim Tae-won (46), co-CEO of InnoRed and a former executive director of Google Korea, to the role. (이재명 대통령이 청와대에 청년미래비서관직을 신설하고 구글코리아 전무 출신 김태원(46) 이노레드 공동대표를 임명했다.)

Kang Yoo-jung, senior presidential spokesperson, stated during a briefing on the 16th, "The Office of the Secretary for Youth and Future was established with the aim of actively addressing youth issues and presenting a vision for the future." She added, "Through this, we seek to create tangible changes that can be easily felt from the perspective of young people." This move comes after the June 3 local elections, which revealed a shift in support among voters in their 20s and 30s. The youth secretary position, originally created under the Moon Jae-in administration, was abolished during the Yoon Suk-yeol government. It has now been revived as a direct subordinate organization under the chief of the presidential staff. Secretary Kim reported to Cheong Wa Dae on the same day to begin his duties. <<> Secretary Kim, born in 1980, attended Cheongdam Elementary, Middle, and High Schools in Seoul before graduating from Korea University with a degree in Sociology. He later served as a managing director (executive director) of global business at Google Korea. He has also held roles such as an adjunct professor at Korea University's School of Media and Communication, and outside director at Korea Investment Financial Holdings and Korea Investment & Securities. He joined InnoRed, an independent advertising agency handling digital advertising for companies, in 2024. In 2013, he participated as a "youth mentor committee member" on the Youth Committee, an advisory body under the President during the Park Geun-hye administration. At the time, he was 33 years old. <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang described Secretary Kim as "a mentor for the younger generation who has actively engaged with various non-profit foundations and consistently shown great interest in youth issues, communicating with young people." She expressed expectations that he "will develop innovative future strategies and creative youth policies from the perspective of young people." The Office of the Secretary for Youth and Future will be responsible for three functions: identifying youth issues and formulating policy responses, expanding youth participation in policy-making, and fostering communication with young people. The youth affairs officer, previously under the Office of the Secretary for National Unity, has been reassigned to the Office of the Secretary for Youth and Future. <<> The creation of the Secretary for Youth and Future position is seen as a measure to prevent the erosion of support among younger demographics. Earlier, on the 2nd, President Lee emphasized during a meeting of senior presidential secretaries that "to develop policies that young people can feel, we must listen to a variety of voices," stressing the need for policies tailored to the younger generation. However, following the announcement of Secretary Kim's appointment on the same day, comments in pro-government online communities included reactions such as, "Is it appropriate to appoint a flashy-spec, 40-something corporate executive to oversee youth policy?" (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 16일 브리핑에서 “청년미래비서관실은 청년들의 문제를 적극적으로 해결하고 미래 비전을 제시하자는 취지에서 신설됐다”며 “이를 통해 청년의 관점에서 쉽게 체감할 실질적 변화를 만들어가고자 한다”고 밝혔다. 6·3 지방선거에서 2030 표심 이탈을 확인한 데 따른 것이다. 문재인 정부 때 만든 청년비서관은 윤석열 정부에서 폐지됐는데, 이번에 대통령비서실장 산하 직속 조직으로 부활했다. 김 비서관은 이날부터 청와대에 출근해 업무를 시작했다.)

item.title: Growing Voices in Ruling Party for Retention... Party Leadership Candidates Unanimously Say "Abolish Supplementary Investigation Powers" (여당 내 존치 목소리 커지는데… 당권주자들 일제히 “보완수사권 폐지”)
item.description:
Growing Voices in Ruling Party for Retention... Party Leadership Candidates Unanimously Say "Abolish Supplementary Investigation Powers" (여당 내 존치 목소리 커지는데… 당권주자들 일제히 “보완수사권 폐지”)

While voices within the Democratic Party of Korea calling for the partial retention of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers are growing, party leadership candidates—former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, lawmaker Song Young-gil, and former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae—reaffirmed their stance on the 16th, saying, "The supplementary investigation powers must be abolished." This is seen as a move to cater to the sentiments of hardline supporters. (더불어민주당에서 검찰 보완수사권 일부 존치 주장이 커지고 있지만, 당권 주자인 김민석 전 국무총리와 송영길 의원, 정청래 전 대표는 16일 “보완수사권을 폐지해야 한다”는 입장을 재확인했다. 강성 지지층 표심을 의식한 것이다.)

Appearing on SBS on the same day, former Prime Minister Kim stated regarding the supplementary investigation powers, "While there is much public opinion that we should approach it with some adjustments, as a former prime minister, I said it would be better to settle it by abolishing the supplementary investigation powers." Regarding the timeline for processing the revised Criminal Procedure Act that includes the abolition of the supplementary investigation powers, Kim said, "It would be good to sort out the law by August," adding, "Since other political schedules will follow after the August 17 national convention, we shouldn't let it pass that point. It's best to finalize it as quickly as possible under the current leadership." <<> Lawmaker Song appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel on the same day and argued for the complete abolition of the supplementary investigation powers, saying, "I have consistently maintained the position that the right to request supplementary investigations is sufficient." Song stated, "If the police do not heed the prosecution's request for supplementary investigation, the investigative agency can be transferred, and disciplinary action can be taken," adding, "There is no police force that would refuse that." He further said, "If I become the party leader, I will pass a bill that allows the police to request warrants for criminal acts by prosecutors through Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) investigators, thereby checking the prosecution's monopoly on warrant requests." <<> Former Representative Jeong held a discussion on the same day at the National Assembly with lawmakers Kim Yong-min, Choi Min-hee, and Lee Seong-yoon, who advocate for the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. "Prosecution reform is not just the flag of the Democratic Party but of the entire democratic and progressive camp," he said. "We must completely abolish the supplementary investigation powers and solve the problem through other means." Former Representative Jeong stated, "The harm caused by the prosecution is ten times, a hundred times greater than that caused by the police," adding, "The prosecution's concealment, manipulation, and distortion of cases are ten times, a hundred times worse than the police's." He said, "Giving the prosecution investigative powers is another way of saying we shouldn't pursue prosecution reform," and warned, "If we fail at prosecution reform, the general election will also become difficult." <<> As the Democratic Party begins accepting candidate registrations for the national convention over the next two days, five candidates are running for party leader: former Prime Minister Kim, lawmaker Song, former Representative Jeong, as well as lawmaker Ko Min-jeong, and former South Jeolla Province Gangjin County Council Chair Kim Bo-mi. Through the cut-off (preliminary primary) on the 21st, only three of the five will advance to the main primary. (김 전 총리는 이날 SBS에 출연해 보완수사권에 대해 “일정하게 보완하면서 접근해야 하지 않느냐는 여론이 많지만, 총리로서 ‘(보완수사권) 폐지로 정리하는 게 좋겠다’고 했다”고 말했다. 김 전 총리는 보완수사권 폐지를 담은 형사소송법 개정안 처리 시기와 관련해선 “8월 전에는 법이 다 정리되는 게 좋다”며 “8·17 전당대회 이후 다른 정치적 일정이 진행되기 때문에 그때를 넘기지 않아야 한다. 현 지도부 하에서 최대한 빨리 마무리하는 게 좋다”고 했다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min's ‘Doomed Lee’ Theory… Behind It, a Struggle for Nomination Rights in the Next General Election Between New and Old Factions (유시민이 던진 ‘李 필패론’… 그 뒤엔 신·구 주류 총선 공천권 싸움)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min's ‘Doomed Lee’ Theory… Behind It, a Struggle for Nomination Rights in the Next General Election Between New and Old Factions (유시민이 던진 ‘李 필패론’… 그 뒤엔 신·구 주류 총선 공천권 싸움)

Regarding Yoo Si-min’s statement that “President Lee Jae-myung is heading toward an inevitable path of failure,” pro-Lee figures responded on the 16th, saying, “How dare he say that about a president with four years left in his term,” “It’s a curse and a slander,” and “He crossed the line.” With the Democratic Party’s August 17 national convention just a month away, Yoo’s near-vitriolic comments aimed at President Lee prompted ruling party insiders to suggest, “Isn’t this a declaration of war by the pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions, represented by Yoo, that they will absolutely not let the pro-Lee faction take the party leadership—which controls nomination rights for the 2028 general election—this time?” <<> The Democratic Party’s support base is split between the pro-Lee new mainstream, which has a centrist and conservative leaning and flowed in around the presidential election, and the pro-Roh and pro-Moon old mainstream. These groups are respectively backing former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae for the next party leader. Against this backdrop, Yoo criticized President Lee’s moderate and pragmatic approach aimed at expanding his outreach as “dangerous.” In effect, it was a warning that continuing this path would lead to defeat not only in the next general election but also in the presidential election. The pro-Roh and pro-Moon side called it “well-intentioned advice,” but the pro-Lee faction saw it as “an outright message to Democratic Party supporters to vote for former Representative Jeong.” <<> Yoo has directly targeted President Lee multiple times this year. In February, referring to the pro-Lee faction that took the lead in pushing for the withdrawal of the indictment in the president’s case, he said, “Either those people are crazy or I am, and I don’t think I’m crazy.” In March, after dividing the ruling party’s support base into A, B, and C groups, he described Group B, dubbed “New Lee Jae-myung,” as “people who would abandon the president first if a crisis arises.” Then, on the 15th, he even claimed, “The reason prosecutorial reform has been stalled for over a year is that President Lee doesn’t want it.” He also bluntly added, “The president’s urban renewal and redevelopment efforts won’t succeed,” “The Democratic Party tried this ‘structural majority’ that the president speaks of in the past and got crushed in the general election,” and “The moment the Democratic Party accepts the president’s control, the party will disintegrate.” This was interpreted as a message for President Lee to stop interfering in party affairs, such as nominations, as he has been trying to control the Democratic Party by distancing himself from the old mainstream and newly recruiting pro-Lee forces. <<> A senior Democratic Party lawmaker said, “Yoo’s words conceal a determination not to lose the upper hand in the hegemonic struggle over the party’s mainstream,” adding, “It’s as if the pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions sent a message to President Lee, who has long walked the path of a non-mainstream figure, saying, ‘It’s time for you to step back.’” Another pro-Moon lawmaker remarked, “Isn’t this a sense of urgency that a pro-Lee party leader must not control nomination rights for the next general election?” This suggests that Yoo stepped forward to prevent a repeat of the 2024 general election under President Lee’s leadership, when he used so-called “purge nominations” to eliminate pro-Moon figures and fill the party with pro-Lee loyalists. A ruling party insider noted, “Regardless of who becomes party leader, the emotional rift is deepening to the point where a party split must be considered.” <<> The presidential office has taken a stance of not directly responding to Yoo’s remarks. Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong told reporters that day, “We won’t respond separately to comments from a specific individual,” but added, “We have never wavered in our commitment to the core value of prosecutorial reform—the separation of investigation and prosecution.” Earlier, Yoo had claimed, “President Lee does not want a complete separation of investigation and prosecution.” A ruling party insider explained, “This is likely considering that if the president joins the debate directly, the national convention could harden into a ‘Lee Jae-myung vs. Jeong Cheong-rae’ confrontation.” However, presidential aides expressed considerable displeasure over Yoo’s remarks. One source close to the president said, “How can you use the word ‘doomed’ for an administration barely a year old?” and emphasized, “Despite any obstruction, the president’s redevelopment efforts toward re-election will continue.” <<> The Democratic Party was in an uproar all day over Yoo’s comments. Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won wrote on Facebook, “Author Yoo also shook and tormented the DJ (Kim Dae-jung) government for all five years back then. Who is he offering as an alternative as he shakes President Lee, who has just been in office for a year?” Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu also said, “I can’t agree with Yoo’s words, and they are significantly distorted.” Lawmaker Kim Nam-joon, a close aide to President Lee, added, “This feels less like constructive criticism for reform and more like vitriol that increases the enemies of reform. It suddenly made me think the president must be very lonely.” <<> Reactions from party leadership candidates were mixed. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said, “It seems to go beyond the realm of ordinary commentary.” Regarding Yoo, who had also strongly criticized former Presidents Kim Dae-jung and Roh Moo-hyun, Kim added, “He wasn’t always right. I wonder why he did that.” Lawmaker Song Young-gil also commented, “Expressions like curses and slander are inappropriate.” Pro-Moon lawmaker Ko Min-jung added, “Trying to categorize everything into good and evil is itself a path to failure.” In contrast, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, when asked by reporters, “What do you think of Yoo’s remarks?” replied, “No comment.” (유시민씨가 “이재명 대통령이 필연적인 실패의 길로 가고 있다”고 한 발언을 두고 친명계에서는 16일 “4년 남은 대통령에게 감히 할 소리냐” “저주와 악담” “금도를 넘었다”는 반응이 이어졌다. 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 한 달 앞두고 유씨가 이 대통령에게 독설에 가까운 말을 쏟아내자, 여권 관계자들은 “유씨로 대변되는 친노·친문 세력이 2028년 총선 공천권을 쥔 당 대표직을 이번엔 절대 친명계에 뺏기지 않겠다는 선전포고를 한 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party's preliminary primary deposit for Supreme Council members quadrupled at once (민주당 최고위원 예비경선 기탁금 한번에 4배 올라)
item.description:
Democratic Party's preliminary primary deposit for Supreme Council members quadrupled at once (민주당 최고위원 예비경선 기탁금 한번에 4배 올라)

As the Democratic Party of Korea, ahead of its August national convention, raised the preliminary primary deposits for candidates running for party leader and Supreme Council members, some candidates voiced objections on the 16th. The deposits are used to cover election costs and also serve to prevent a flood of candidates; the preliminary primary deposit for Supreme Council candidates has risen from 5 million won to 20 million won within a year. (8월 전당대회를 앞둔 더불어민주당이 당대표와 최고위원 선거 후보자가 내는 예비경선 기탁금을 인상하자 16일 일부 후보가 반발했다. 기탁금은 선거 비용으로 쓰고 후보 난립을 막는 역할도 하는데, 최고위원 예비경선 기탁금이 1년새 500만원에서 2000만원으로 오른 것이다.)

Kim Hyung-nam (37), former secretary-general of the Military Human Rights Center and a candidate in the Democratic Party's Supreme Council election, posted on Facebook on the 16th, saying, "The national convention deposit has quadrupled. What is the reason for the increase, and what is the basis for this amount?" He noted, "In the 2022, 2024, and 2025 national conventions, the preliminary primary deposit for Supreme Council members was 5 million won, and even running in the final primary cost 15 million won, but this time, just the preliminary primary is 20 million won." The implication is that the excessive deposit strips non-incumbent politicians of the opportunity to challenge. (민주당 최고위원 선거에 출마하는 김형남(37) 전 군인권센터 사무국장은 16일 페이스북에 “전당대회 기탁금이 4배로 올랐다. 인상된 이유와 책정 기준이 무엇이냐”는 글을 올렸다. 그는 “2022년, 2024년, 2025년 전당대회에서 최고위원 예비경선 기탁금은 500만원이었고, 본경선까지 뛰어도 1500만원이었는데, 이번엔 예비경선만 2000만원”이라고 했다. 과도한 기탁금이 원외 정치인의 도전 기회마저 뺏는다는 취지다.)

On the 14th, the Democratic Party announced candidate registration for the national convention, demanding a 20 million won preliminary primary deposit from those running for party leader and Supreme Council positions. In last year's convention, the deposit was 15 million won for party leader candidates and 5 million won for Supreme Council candidates. Candidates who pass the preliminary primary and advance to the final primary must pay an additional deposit. Including the preliminary primary, the total deposit for running is 100 million won for party leader candidates and 50 million won for Supreme Council candidates. (민주당은 지난 14일 전당대회 후보 등록 공고를 통해 당대표 후보와 최고위원 출마자에게 예비경선 기탁금 2000만원을 요구했다. 지난해 전당대회에선 당대표 후보 1500만원, 최고위원 500만원을 냈다. 예비경선을 통과해 본경선에 진출한 후보는 기탁금을 추가로 내야 한다. 예비경선을 포함해 출마를 위해 내는 기탁금은 당대표 후보 1억원, 최고위원 후보 5000만원이다.)

Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister and candidate for party leader, said on X (formerly Twitter) on the same day, "Under leader Lee Jae-myung, deposits were lowered in line with a public funding initiative, but now they've been raised more than before," adding, "At the very least, young candidates should have received a much bigger reduction. It's not as if the party can't afford to hold the convention without these deposits." While the Democratic Party offers a 50% reduction on deposits for young non-incumbent candidates aged 39 or under, critics point out that the increase in the deposit itself is problematic. (당대표 후보인 김민석 전 국무총리는 이날 X(옛 트위터)에서 “이재명 당대표 시절 공영제 취지로 인하했던 기탁금을 전보다 더 올렸다”면서 “적어도 젊은 후보자들에게는 훨씬 더 감면했어야 한다. 기탁금이 없으면 전당대회를 못 치를 당 형편도 아니지 않느냐”라고 했다. 민주당은 39세 이하 원외 청년 후보에 한해 기탁금을 50% 감면해 주고 있지만 기탁금 자체가 인상된 것은 문제라는 지적이다.)

The Central Election Management Committee of the Democratic Party stated, "The increase in deposits was unavoidable due to rising election costs from the growth in party membership." A party official explained, "Since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the number of dues-paying members has grown significantly to about 1.6 million, and as the number of members increases, election costs rise proportionally," adding, "There is also an aspect of raising deposits to prevent an excessive number of candidates." (민주당 중앙당 선거관리위원회 측은 “당원 수 증가로 선거 비용이 늘어 기탁금 인상이 불가피했다”는 입장이다. 민주당 관계자는 “이재명 정부 출범 이후 권리당원 수가 크게 늘어 160만명에 달하는데, 당원 숫자가 늘어날수록 선거 비용도 비례해서 증가하는 구조”라면서 “후보자 난립을 막기 위해 기탁금을 늘린 측면도 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Could North Korea Provide Military Support to China in a Taiwan Emergency? Wang Huning in Pyongyang, Possibility of Discussing Response (대만 유사시에도 北이 中 군사 지원?… 평양 간 왕후닝, 대응 논의 가능성)
item.description:
Could North Korea Provide Military Support to China in a Taiwan Emergency? Wang Huning in Pyongyang, Possibility of Discussing Response (대만 유사시에도 北이 中 군사 지원?… 평양 간 왕후닝, 대응 논의 가능성)

Wang Huning, the fourth-ranking official in the Chinese Communist Party and chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), is visiting North Korea from the 15th to the 17th to commemorate the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China friendship treaty, leading to observations that discussions on a response to a Taiwan emergency may be underway between the two countries. Wang Huning is a key foreign policy strategist for Chinese President Xi Jinping and oversees the united front policy regarding Taiwan. (중국 공산당 서열 4위인 왕후닝 전국인민정치협상회의(정협) 주석이 북·중 우호 조약 체결 65주년 기념을 위해 15~17일 방북하면서 북·중 간에 ‘대만 유사시 대응’ 문제가 논의되고 있다는 관측이 나오고 있다. 왕후닝은 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 외교 책사로, 대만에 대한 통일 전선 정책을 총괄하고 있다.)

On the 16th, China's state-run Xinhua News Agency reported that Wang Huning attended a reception in Pyongyang alongside North Korean Cabinet Premier Pak Thae-song marking the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China friendship treaty. Pak Thae-song visited China from the 10th to the 12th, meeting with President Xi Jinping and others. Following Chairman Kim Jong-un's visit to China last month for talks with Xi, top-level exchanges between the two countries are continuing at an unprecedented pace. (16일 중국 관영 신화통신은 왕후닝이 이날 평양에서 박태성 북한 내각총리와 함께 북·중 우호 조약 체결 65주년 기념 리셉션에 참석했다고 전했다. 박태성은 지난 10~12일 중국을 방문해 시진핑 주석 등을 만났다. 시 주석이 지난달 북한을 찾아 김정은 국무위원장과 회담한 데 이어, 양국 간 최고위급 교류가 전례 없는 속도로 이어지고 있는 것이다.)

On that day, North Korea's Rodong Sinmun reported that Jo Yong-won, a member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Workers' Party of Korea and secretary in charge of organizational affairs of the Party Central Committee, held talks with Wang Huning the previous day to discuss measures to strengthen bilateral relations. Jo Yong-won, a close confidant of Kim Jong-un, called for close "strategic communication and tactical cooperation" between the two countries during the talks, while Wang Huning emphasized the will to drive bilateral relations to "a higher stage." "Strategic communication" typically refers to consultations on regional issues. <<> In this context, there are suggestions that Wang Huning's visit to North Korea may involve consultations on the Taiwan issue. As a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, the highest leadership body, Wang Huning serves as deputy head of the Central Leading Group for Work on Taiwan, the organization overseeing Taiwan policy. The head of this group is President Xi Jinping, and Wang Huning, under his guidance, is the top official responsible for overall strategy on Taiwan. The stated purpose of his visit is to commemorate the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China friendship treaty, which includes a provision that if either party is militarily attacked and enters a "state of war," the other party will provide "military and other assistance without delay." <<> During last month's summit with Xi Jinping, Kim Jong-un stated that North Korea "will continue to unwaveringly uphold the One-China principle and firmly support the policies and positions China adopts to safeguard its core interests." Pak Thae-song, upon meeting Xi Jinping on the 10th, also said he would "resolutely support the protection of China's core interests, including the Taiwan issue." A diplomatic source commented, "This could be a sign that North Korea and China have begun discussions with an eye on a Taiwan emergency." (이날 북한 노동신문은 조용원 노동당 정치국 상무위원 겸 당 중앙위 조직담당 비서가 전날 왕후닝과 회담을 갖고 양국 간 관계 강화 방안을 논의했다고 전했다. 김정은의 최측근인 조용원은 회담에서 양국 간의 “전략적 의사소통과 전술적 협력”을 긴밀히 하자고 했고, 왕후닝은 양국 관계를 “높은 단계에로 추동”하려는 의지를 강조했다. ‘전략적 소통’은 통상 역내 문제에 대한 협의를 뜻한다.)

item.title: ROK-US-Japan Joint Chiefs of Staff: "Continue Trilateral Combined Exercises" (한미일 합참의장 “3국 연합훈련 지속”)
item.description:
ROK-US-Japan Joint Chiefs of Staff: "Continue Trilateral Combined Exercises" (한미일 합참의장 “3국 연합훈련 지속”)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff of South Korea, the United States, and Japan announced that they will continue the annual trilateral combined exercise, "Freedom Edge." Freedom Edge, which involves simultaneous multi-domain operations in the air, underwater, maritime, space, and cyber domains by the three countries, was first conducted in June 2024. At the time, North Korea strongly opposed it, calling it the "Asian version of NATO's framework." As Russia and China, which have close ties with North Korea, turn a blind eye to its nuclear issue, the United States, which maintains the goal of "complete denuclearization of North Korea," is seen as demonstrating its commitment to sustained trilateral cooperation between South Korea, the US, and Japan. <<> According to the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Chairman Admiral Kim Myung-soo of the ROK Joint Chiefs of Staff, Chairman General Charles Q. Brown Jr. of the US Joint Chiefs of Staff, and Chief of Staff General Yoshihide Yoshida of the Japan Self-Defense Forces held the 23rd ROK-US-Japan Joint Chiefs of Staff Meeting in Washington, D.C. on the 15th (local time). In a joint press release, the three chiefs of staff stated that they "reaffirmed the importance of trilateral security cooperation in effectively responding to North Korea's nuclear and missile threats and various regional challenges and threats." <<> The trilateral Joint Chiefs of Staff also announced that they "agreed to continue cooperating towards the complete denuclearization of North Korea in accordance with relevant UN Security Council resolutions." The UN Security Council resolutions stipulate that North Korea must abandon its weapons of mass destruction (WMD) and ballistic missile programs, including nuclear weapons, in a "complete, verifiable, and irreversible manner." Additionally, the three chiefs of staff stated that they "agreed to continue seeking ways to maintain the momentum of trilateral security cooperation, including the conduct of the annual ROK-US-Japan exercise, Freedom Edge." <<> The ROK-US-Japan three countries have conducted Freedom Edge exercises a total of three times so far, in June and November 2024, and September of last year, in the waters near the Korean Peninsula. North Korea has strongly protested against each exercise, and last year, Kim Yo-jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, issued a statement denouncing the exercises as "reckless muscle-flexing." It is reported that the military authorities of South Korea, the US, and Japan are preparing to conduct Freedom Edge in the latter half of this year. <<> Attending the meeting were also General Xavier Brunson, Commander of US Forces Korea; Lieutenant General Stephen Jost, Commander of US Forces Japan; and Lieutenant General George Lovell, Deputy Commander of US Indo-Pacific Command. The three chiefs of staff decided to hold the next meeting in Japan next year. (한·미·일 합참의장이 3국 간 연례 연합훈련인 ‘프리덤 에지(Freedom Edge)’를 계속 실시하겠다고 밝혔다. 한·미·일 3국이 공중·수중·해상·우주·사이버 등에서 동시다발적으로 진행하는 프리덤 에지는 2024년 6월 첫 실시 당시 북한이 “아시아판 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구)의 체모”라고 강력 반발했던 다영역 훈련이다. 북한과 밀착한 러시아와 중국이 북핵 문제를 묵인하고 있는 가운데, ‘북한의 완전한 비핵화’ 목표를 유지 중인 미국이 한·미·일 3국 공동 대응을 지속하겠다는 의지를 보인 것으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: US, UK, and France separate military academies… China has dozens (美·英·佛 사관학교 분리… 中은 수십개로 나눠)
item.description:
US, UK, and France separate military academies… China has dozens (美·英·佛 사관학교 분리… 中은 수십개로 나눠)

Efforts to integrate the army, navy, and air force academies have been attempted in the past, but they failed due to differences of opinion among the branches. Among major overseas countries, the United States, the United Kingdom, and France operate separate military academies, while Canada and Australia have integrated systems. South Korea has operated its military academies based on the U.S. model, its ally. (육·해·공군 사관학교 통합은 과거에도 추진된 적이 있지만 각 군의 의견 차이로 성공하지 못했다. 주요 해외국 중에선 미국·영국·프랑스 등 사관학교가 분리돼 있고, 캐나다·호주 등은 통합 운영하고 있다. 한국은 동맹국인 미국 제도를 바탕으로 사관학교를 운영해왔다.)

In 2009, the Lee Myung-bak administration pushed for integration of the army, navy, and air force academies, stating that "organic cooperation among the three branches is essential for future warfare." A timetable was also set to complete the integration before the end of the presidential term in 2012. Government officials at the time explained the reasons for integration, citing "the need to eradicate entrenched practices like branch-specific selfishness" and that "integrating the academies would reduce waste." (지난 2009년 이명박 정부는 “미래전에서는 육·해·공군의 유기적 협력이 필수적”이라며 육·해·공사 통합을 추진했다. 대통령 임기 막바지인 2012년 전에 통합을 완료하겠다는 시간표도 제시했다. 당시 정부 관계자들은 “자군(自軍) 이기주의 등 군내 폐습은 반드시 해소해야 한다” “사관학교 통합은 낭비를 줄일 것” 등으로 통합의 이유를 설명했다.)

However, the integration did not materialize. The navy and air force strongly opposed it, arguing that "it could further strengthen the army's vested interests." With military leadership already dominated by the army, the concern was whether top cadets would choose the navy or air force after the academies were merged. Some army figures also opposed it, saying "independence would weaken." The integration was eventually pushed aside as a long-term task and fizzled out. It is known that integration was also partially reviewed during the governments of Rhee Syngman, Chun Doo-hwan, and Roh Tae-woo, but was not realized due to disagreements among the branches. (하지만 통합은 이뤄지지 못했다. 해군과 공군에서 “육군의 기득권만 더 강화될 수 있다”고 반발한 영향이 컸다. 군 수뇌부가 이미 육군 중심으로 구성돼 있는데, 사관학교를 통합하면 우수한 생도가 과연 해·공군을 선택하겠느냐는 것이었다. 일부 육군 출신들도 “독립성이 약해진다”며 반대했다. 결국 사관학교 통합은 장기 과제로 밀리며 흐지부지됐다. 이승만·전두환·노태우 정부 때도 사관학교 통합이 일부 검토됐지만 각 군이 이견을 보이는 등 이유로 실현되지 못한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Though not military academies, there are cases where military educational institutions were integrated and later reversed. A notable example is the integration of army combat arms schools in 1983. Originally, the army operated separate schools for infantry, artillery, and engineers based on combat functions. These were merged into a single combat arms school to enhance cooperation. The former infantry school commander became the head of the integrated school, while other branch school commanders served as department heads under him. However, this led to a lack of communication and increased friction among the branches. Ultimately, the system reverted to separate schools six years later in 1989. (사관학교는 아니지만, 군 교육기관을 통합했다가 취소한 사례도 있다. 1983년 육군 전투병과학교 통합이 대표적이다. 원래 육군은 보병·포병·공병학교 등 전투 기능에 따라 별도의 교육 기관을 운영했는데, 협동성을 높인다는 이유로 이를 전투병과학교로 통합한 것이다. 기존 보병학교장을 통합 학교장으로 두고, 각 병과학교장은 그 휘하의 학부장이 됐다. 그러나 각 기능 간의 소통 부족과 반목이 심해지는 부작용이 나타났다. 결국 6년 만인 1989년 다시 독립 학교 체제로 돌아갔다.)

Joo Eun-sik, head of the Korea Strategic Research Institute and a retired brigadier general, said, "This is a prime example showing that physically integrating organizations does not automatically create cooperation," adding that "a hasty push to merge military academies would likely only produce negative side effects." (주은식 한국전략문제연구소장(예비역 준장)은 “조직을 물리적으로 통합한다고 협동성이 자동으로 생기는 것이 아니라는 점을 보여준 대표적인 사례”라며 “사관학교 통합도 섣불리 추진될 경우 부작용만 낳을 가능성이 크다”고 말했다.)

The operating models of military academies vary by country. Major military powers with large standing forces often have separate academies. In the U.S., West Point, the Naval Academy, and the Air Force Academy are independent. West Point opened in 1802, boasting 224 years of history and tradition, while the Naval Academy and Air Force Academy mark 181 and 72 years this year, respectively. The UK and France also operate separate military academies. China has dozens of separate military schools, and Russia operates military educational institutions by branch. (사관학교 운영 방식은 국가마다 다르다. 상비군 규모가 큰 군사 강대국은 사관학교가 분리된 경우가 많다. 미국은 육사, 해사, 공사가 각각 분리돼 있다. 미 육사는 1802년 개교해 224년의 역사와 전통을 가지고 있고, 해사·공사도 올해 각각 개교 181년, 72년을 맞는다. 영국과 프랑스도 사관학교를 분리 운영 중이다. 중국은 수십 개의 군사학교를 분리해 놓았고, 러시아도 군종별로 군사 교육기관을 운영한다.)

Australia and Canada run integrated military academies. Both countries have standing forces of about 60,000, while South Korea's is estimated at 450,000. Japan also operates the National Defense Academy, an integrated military academy. However, this reflects the historical lesson from World War II, when severe rivalry between the army and navy hindered troop deployment efforts. (호주와 캐나다는 통합 사관학교를 운영 중이다. 두 국가의 상비군은 각각 6만여 명 정도인데 한국군 상비군은 45만명으로 추정된다. 일본도 통합 사관학교 격인 방위대학교를 운영하고 있다. 다만 제2차 세계대전 당시 육군과 해군 간 첨예한 갈등으로 병력 운용에 어려움을 겪은 역사적 교훈을 반영했다는 특수성이 있다.)
